race.description: Victor Harbor Motor Co Mdn Plate
race.comment: Very little to get excited about in the exposed form so the first starter KEEP GOING (8) gets his chance. Has been to the jump-outs twice and won both times for the Jolly/Potter stable. Only needs to possess moderate ability to take this out. BUFFO (2) was in commission first-up over 900m at Murray Bridge but didn't finish his race off after showing pace to the corner. Strips fitter and should offer much more resistance this time. MAKE ME A MATCH (12) showed pace but weakened in the concluding stages on debut over 1250m at Morphettville Parks last start. Finds a far easier maiden so don't write her off. MURTLE KOMBAT (13) found the line well on debut at Bordertown and an extra 100m today is a plus.
